name: hanria
summary: Check a proposed agent action against an operator-authored mandate and receive permit, deny or escalate with the governing clause, then append the decision to a hash-chained local log. Works with no runtime and no network. Advisory: it checks and records, it cannot enforce.
critical_notice: This skill checks and records; it CANNOT enforce. A skill is context and can be ignored or bypassed, so an agent that ignores a deny still performs the operation. Enforcement requires that protected credentials, tools, keys or worker processes be reachable only through a component that can refuse. As of 2026-09-04 no released, packaged or obtainable HANRIA runtime exists.

detect.note: Expected to report absent: no released, packaged or obtainable runtime exists. Not required for checking or recording.

agent_obligations.on_deny: Stop. Do not attempt the operation by another path. Report the denial and its reason.
agent_obligations.on_escalate: Report that approval is pending. Do not proceed and do not retry in a loop.
never: place a credential, secret, key, or token in a request
describe an action as HANRIA-governed when no runtime answered
describe the enforcement runtime as available or released, or describe HANRIA as audited, certified, or compliant
describe a log entry as a receipt, attestation, or evidence to a third party
agent_obligations.on_error: Treat as deny. Report the text. Never proceed on an error.

not_claimed: that this skill prevents, blocks, or enforces anything
that credential detection in a request is complete; it is a heuristic and can be evaded
that the decision log detects truncation without a separately retained head
trademark registration or completed clearance in the name HANRIA
third-party security audit, certification, or regulatory approval
published receipt format, public verifier, or interoperability standard
custody of funds, digital assets, or keys
runtime_required_for: Enforcement only. Checking and recording are entirely local.
